sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Thirsty - Secrets is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hello again. I was able to extract some scraps of information about a certain drug from the diary you brought. The owner of the diary used it frequently. It's some sort of combat stimulant, I think you might be interested in it. I can provide you with samples if you help me reproduce and test it. Here's a list of the items you'll need."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - Unlocks 12-13 hours after completion of Thirsty - Echo

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Hand over the 2 found in raid items: Adrenaline injector
- Hand over the 4 found in raid items: Bottle of OLOLO Multivitamins
- Hand over the 3 found in raid items: Bottle of saline solution

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- 6× 2A2-(b-TG) stimulant injector Note: Only obtainable by buyers of the "Edge of Darkness" edition of the game.
- Unlocks craft for 2A2-(b-TG) stimulant injector at Medstation level 2
- 1× Injector case
"I was sure you'd be interested in this! Here are the results of the work."
